"""txtme im Chat: die Funktion hinter dem Fenster unten rechts im Shop und dem Antwort-Assistenten in Backstage (/api/gast, Vercel,
Python ohne Zusatzpakete). Läuft im Projekt txtme-backstage (Frankfurt), nicht auf dem Shop-Server: der liefert nur Dateien aus.
Wissen: gast_wissen.txt (Wortlaut der englischen Seiten des Shops und der Katalog mit Preisen, Grössen, Farben, Bestand).
Schlüssel: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID; Speicher für Backstage über /api/fragen (GAST_GEHEIM).
Vorlage: der Chat der Maeder-Häuser (Carlton-Europe) und von Salt & Silver, für einen Shop umgebaut (keine Buchung, kein Wetter,
stattdessen «Find your piece», Englisch zuerst, Antworten über Rechner-Grenzen hinweg nur von den eigenen Seiten).

Kopie für das Werkzeug Chat Team (lokal, werkzeuge/chat-team/_gast/): unverändert bis auf den Schalter KI. Ohne CHAT_TEAM_KI=1 in der
Umgebung antwortet jede Stelle, die das Modell riefe, mit einer Probe aus probe_ki.py (Master E18/E23, AUFTRAG Regel 6); der Schlüssel
wird dann nie gelesen. Die Online-Fassung in _cloud/txtme-quellen/backstage-online/api/gast.py bleibt, wie sie ist."""

ANWEISUNG = f"""You are the chat on the txtme.social website and shop. txtme.social is a European social app from Amsterdam built around meeting people in real life: every piece of merch carries the wearer's personal QR code; someone scans it, and only then they are connected. # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Grenzen je Besucher und Tag (im Speicher der laufenden Funktion)
SCHLOSS = threading.Lock()
BESUCHER = collections.defaultdict(list)
TAG = {'tag': '', 'n': 0, 'anfrage': 0}

def erlaubt(ip, art='gast'):
    jetzt, heute = time.time(), time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    with SCHLOSS:
        if TAG['tag'] != heute:
            TAG.update(tag=heute, n=0, anfrage=0); BESUCHER.clear()
        if art == 'anfrage':
            if TAG['anfrage'] >= GRENZEN['anfrage_tag']:
                return False
            TAG['anfrage'] += 1
            return True
        z = [t for t in BESUCHER[ip] if jetzt - t < 86400]
        if len(z) >= GRENZEN['besucher_tag'] or len([t for t in z if jetzt - t < 600]) >= GRENZEN['besucher_10min'] or TAG['n'] >= GRENZEN['gesamt_tag']:
            BESUCHER[ip] = z
            return False
        z.append(jetzt); BESUCHER[ip] = z; TAG['n'] += 1
        return True

GRENZE_TEXT = {'en': f'You have asked a great many questions in a short time. So that everyone gets an answer, I pause here for a moment. The team is happy to help directly: {SUPPORT}.',
               'de': f'Du hast in kurzer Zeit sehr viele Fragen gestellt. Damit alle eine Antwort bekommen, mache ich hier kurz Pause. Das Team hilft dir direkt: {SUPPORT}.'}
NICHTS = {'en': f'I cannot help with that here. Write to the team at {SUPPORT}.',
          'de': f'Dazu kann ich hier nichts sagen. Schreib dem Team an {SUPPORT}.'}
GERNE = {'en': 'Sure. Pick category, size and colour, I show you what fits.', 'de': 'Gerne. Wähl Kategorie, Größe und Farbe, ich zeige dir, was passt.'}

def _api(koerper):
    if not KI:
        raise ValueError('DEMO · The model is off in the demo (CHAT_TEAM_KI=1 and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY switch it on). This step answers with a demo instead.')
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', data=json.dumps(koerper).encode('utf-8'), method='POST',
        headers={'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'], 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
                 'anthropic-workspace-id': os.environ.get('ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID', '')})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=55) as r:
        return json.load(r)


def _sprache(text, sp):
    """Sprache der letzten Frage: Englisch ist die Regel; deutsche, niederländische, französische und spanische Fragen erkennen."""
    worte = set(re.findall(r"[a-zäöüéèàçñ']+", text.lower()))
    if len(worte & {'ich', 'und', 'ist', 'das', 'die', 'der', 'wie', 'kann', 'ihr', 'gibt', 'welche', 'größe', 'groesse', 'versand', 'nicht', 'ein', 'eine'}) >= 2: return 'de'
    if len(worte & {'ik', 'het', 'een', 'kan', 'hoe', 'maat', 'verzending', 'jullie', 'niet', 'wat', 'welke', 'retour'}) >= 2: return 'nl'
    if len(worte & {'je', 'vous', 'est', 'une', 'taille', 'livraison', 'comment', 'quelle', 'peut', 'retour', 'avez'}) >= 2: return 'fr'
    if len(worte & {'yo', 'una', 'talla', 'envío', 'envio', 'cómo', 'como', 'puedo', 'tienen', 'cuál', 'devolver'}) >= 2: return 'es'
    if len(worte & {'the', 'is', 'are', 'do', 'can', 'you', 'what', 'how', 'size', 'ship', 'return', 'my', 'have', 'which'}) >= 2: return 'en'
    return sp if sp in SPRACHE else 'en'


def frage(messages, heute='', sprache='en', seite=''):
    verlauf = []
    for m in messages[-HOECHSTENS_NACHRICHTEN:]:
        rolle = 'assistant' if m.get('role') == 'assistant' else 'user'
        inhalt = str(m.get('content', ''))[:HOECHSTENS_ZEICHEN].strip()
        if not inhalt:
            continue
        if verlauf and verlauf[-1]['role'] == rolle:
            verlauf[-1]['content'] += '\n' + inhalt
        else:
            verlauf.append({'role': rolle, 'content': inhalt})
    if not verlauf or verlauf[0]['role'] != 'user':
        verlauf.insert(0, {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Hello'})
    if verlauf[-1]['role'] != 'user':
        verlauf.append({'role': 'user', 'content': 'Please continue.'})
    sp = _sprache(verlauf[-1]['content'], sprache)
    if not KI:
        return probe_ki.frage(verlauf, sp)
    zusatz = f'\n\nToday is {heute or time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}. The customer is on the page {seite or "/"}. Answer in {SPRACHE.get(sp, "English")}.'
    system = [{'type': 'text', 'text': ANWEISUNG, 'cache_control': {'type': 'ephemeral'}}, {'type': 'text', 'text': zusatz}]
    antwort = _api({'model': MODELL, 'max_tokens': GRENZE, 'tools': WERKZEUGE, 'system': system, 'messages': verlauf})
    if antwort.get('stop_reason') == 'refusal':
        return {'text': NICHTS.get(sp, NICHTS['en']), 'belegt': False, 'thema': 'declined'}
    text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in antwort.get('content', []) if b.get('type') == 'text').strip()
    werk = {b.get('name'): b.get('input') for b in antwort.get('content', []) if b.get('type') == 'tool_use'}
    maske, lucke = werk.get('produktfinder'), werk.get('nicht_belegt')
    # Ruft der Chat den Finder auf, endet sein Text dort. Fragte der Kunde dazu noch etwas, bleibt das sonst offen: ein zweiter,
    # kurzer Schritt ergänzt nur, was noch fehlt (der Zwischenspeicher macht ihn billig).
    if maske and antwort.get('stop_reason') == 'tool_use':
        try:
            erg = _api({'model': MODELL, 'max_tokens': GRENZE, 'tools': WERKZEUGE, 'system': system,
                        'messages': verlauf + [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': antwort['content']},
                                               {'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'tool_result', 'tool_use_id': b['id'],
                                                'content': '«Find your piece» now stands below your answer. If a question of the customer (other than which pieces exist) is still unanswered, answer it now as at most five points "- Keyword: fact", only with facts that are in KNOWLEDGE. No introduction, no heading, no bold, no question at the end, do not mention the finder. If everything is answered, reply only with OK.'}
                                                for b in antwort['content'] if b.get('type') == 'tool_use']}]})
            mehr = ''.join(x.get('text', '') for x in erg.get('content', []) if x.get('type') == 'text').strip()
            if mehr and erg.get('stop_reason') != 'refusal' and mehr.rstrip('.').upper() != 'OK':
                text = (text + '\n' + mehr).strip()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        if text.endswith(':'):
            text = text.rsplit('\n', 1)[0].strip() if '\n' in text else ''
    if not text:
        text = (GERNE if maske else NICHTS).get(sp, (GERNE if maske else NICHTS)['en'])
    n = antwort.get('usage', {})
    return {'text': text, 'maske': maske, 'belegt': not lucke, 'thema': (lucke or {}).get('thema', ''), 'sprache': sp,
            'tokens': {'ein': n.get('input_tokens'), 'cache': n.get('cache_read_input_tokens'), 'aus': n.get('output_tokens')}}


def anfrage(mail, hinweis='', meta=None):
    if not KI:
        m = meta or {}
        return probe_ki.anfrage(mail, hinweis, m.get('art', 'support'), m.get('name', ''), m.get('sprache', 'en'), SUPPORT, HAUS['adresse'])
    antwort = _api({
        'model': MODELL, 'max_tokens': 3000 if 'haiku' in MODELL else 7000,
        'system': [{'type': 'text', 'text': ANFRAGE, 'cache_control': {'type': 'ephemeral'}}, {'type': 'text', 'text': f'Today is {time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}.'}],
        'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'MESSAGE:\n' + mail[:12000] + ('\n\nNOTE FROM THE TEAM:\n' + hinweis[:2000] if hinweis.strip() else '')}]})
    if antwort.get('stop_reason') == 'refusal':
        return {'text': '', 'fehler': 'This message cannot be answered automatically. Please write the reply yourself.'}
    text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in antwort.get('content', []) if b.get('type') == 'text').strip()
    mail_teil, _, team = text.partition('\n---')
    m = re.match(r'\s*Subject:\s*(.+)\n', mail_teil)
    return {'betreff': m.group(1).strip() if m else '', 'text': (mail_teil[m.end():] if m else mail_teil).strip(), 'team': team.strip()}


ABDECKEN = [(re.compile(r'[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+'), '[e-mail]'), (re.compile(r'(?:\+|00)?\d[\d\s/().-]{7,}\d'), '[number]')]

def merke(host, daten):
    """Frage und Antwort an den Speicher für Backstage (fragen.js). Adressen und Nummern der Kunden werden vorher abgedeckt."""
    geheim = os.environ.get('GAST_GEHEIM')
    if not geheim or not host:
        return
    for muster, ersatz in ABDECKEN:
        daten['frage'] = muster.sub(ersatz, daten.get('frage', ''))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(f'https://{host}/api/fragen', data=json.dumps(daten).encode('utf-8'), method='POST',
                                     headers={'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-gast-geheim': geheim})
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=4).close()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass


def herkunft_ok(herkunft):
    """Nur das Fenster auf den eigenen Seiten darf fragen (und Roberts Rechner zum Prüfen)."""
    if not herkunft:
        return True
    h = herkunft.rstrip('/')
    if any(h.startswith(x) for x in HAUS['herkunft']):
        return True
    return bool(re.match(r'^https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|\[::1\])(:\d+)?$', h))


class handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _kopf(self, code, laenge=0, art='application/json; charset=utf-8'):
        herkunft = self.headers.get('origin') or ''
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', art)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        if herkunft and herkunft_ok(herkunft):
            self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', herkunft)
            self.send_header('Vary', 'Origin')
            self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'content-type, x-backstage')
            self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
            self.send_header('Access-Control-Max-Age', '86400')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(laenge))
        self.end_headers()

    def _sende(self, code, daten):
        roh = json.dumps(daten, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
        self._kopf(code, len(roh))
        self.wfile.write(roh)

    def _ip(self):
        return (self.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or self.client_address[0] or '').split(',')[0].strip()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._kopf(204)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._sende(200, {'ok': True, 'modell': MODELL if KI else 'demo', 'ki': KI, 'wissen_zeichen': len(WISSEN), 'stand': HAUS.get('stand', '')})

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            host = (self.headers.get('host') or '').split(':')[0]
            herkunft = self.headers.get('origin') or self.headers.get('referer') or ''
            if not herkunft_ok(herkunft):
                return self._sende(403, {'fehler': 'not allowed'})
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0)
            if n > 40000:
                return self._sende(413, {'fehler': 'too long'})
            daten = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b'{}')
            if daten.get('modus') == 'anfrage':
                mail = str(daten.get('mail') or '').strip()
                if len(mail) < 20:
                    return self._sende(400, {'fehler': 'Please paste the message.'})
                if not erlaubt(self._ip(), 'anfrage'):
                    return self._sende(429, {'fehler': 'Enough drafts for today. Tomorrow it continues.'})
                return self._sende(200, anfrage(mail, str(daten.get('hinweis') or '')))
            messages = daten.get('messages') or []
            if not isinstance(messages, list):
                return self._sende(400, {'fehler': 'messages missing'})
            sp = str(daten.get('sprache') or 'en')[:2]
            if not erlaubt(self._ip()):
                return self._sende(200, {'text': GRENZE_TEXT.get(sp, GRENZE_TEXT['en']), 'grenze': True})
            a = frage(messages, heute=str(daten.get('heute', ''))[:10], sprache=sp, seite=str(daten.get('seite', ''))[:80])
            letzte = next((str(m.get('content', '')) for m in reversed(messages) if m.get('role') == 'user'), '')
            merke(host, {'frage': letzte[:HOECHSTENS_ZEICHEN], 'antwort': a['text'][:2000], 'belegt': a.get('belegt', True), 'thema': a.get('thema', ''),
                         'sprache': a.get('sprache', sp), 'finder': bool(a.get('maske')), 'seite': str(daten.get('seite', ''))[:80]})

dateien.anleitung.html:
Chat TeamGuide · txtme.social
Back to the tool

How Chat Team works.

Chat Team is the page behind the chat on txtme.social. The chat answers customers from the wording of the website and the catalogue; this is where the team sees what comes out of it and what it has to do. Nothing is sent from here, and nothing is published.

01

Inbox

Every request from the site and the chat window: waiting list, press, partners, support, messages. A new request is marked «New»; opening it marks it as read.

  1. Open a request on the left. On the right you see the details, the message and, if the customer wrote in the chat, the conversation.
  2. «Write the letter» drafts a reply. Work in it like in Canva: click selects a part, drag moves it, the corners change the size, double click writes. «Text only» shows subject and text as plain fields.
  3. «Copy text» puts the letter on the clipboard, «Save as PDF» prints it as it stands. Paste it into your mail program and send it yourself.
  4. «Done» ticks the request off, «Open again» brings it back. The bin deletes it for good, for example when the customer asks for it.

Requests in another language carry «Read in English»: a reading copy that is not sent.

02

What was asked

Every question to the chat, by topic, with the answer the chat gave. Questions marked «without answer» had nothing on the website. «Add the answer» writes it once; from then on the chat answers with it. While the online part is off (see «Check»), that is the chat of this tool; the chat on the website gets it once the online part is switched on. «Tick off without answer» keeps the question in the log without the mark.

03

Added by the team

The answers you added. Change or remove them here when something changes. The entries marked «Example» are invented and the chat does not know them.

04

What the chat knows

The memory of the chat by area: the company, the app, the pieces, shipping and payment, press, contact, events. Tap a row to change it or to switch it off; «As on the website» brings the original back. «New knowledge» takes written text straight in; links, documents and photos need the model.

«Check the chat» asks the chat with the knowledge as it stands now, without the question going into the log.

05

Try the chat

The button at the top right opens the chat the way customers see it. Questions from there count as examples.

06

Demo and the real chat

In this demo the chat answers without a model, from the recorded answers and the knowledge; the drafts quote no facts. The real chat on txtme.social keeps its questions and requests online; the connection is switched on once at delivery and needs the key of the online part. The check page shows the state of everything.
